title: An AI travel assistant
offer: A shared itinerary, organised booking details and useful alternatives when plans change. You stay in control of every booking.

method.data: 20 manually authored traveller scenarios. Maximum prices and quotes are fictional. They are not extracted from research or generated by MiroFish.
method.decision_rule: Illustrative paid choice if max_gbp_per_trip >= selected price. Otherwise keep free tools.
method.retrieval: Actual lexical retrieval over saved, curated public research summaries. Not a live web search or vector database.
method.rag: Retrieval is implemented; generation in this presentation is replaced by authored fixtures. The separate lab implements actual MiroFish/OASIS/Ollama interviews.
stack: Separate lab: MiroFish-local / OASIS / Ollama / SQLite
